advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Report the normalized ref in the `comment_ticket` success message for consistency with what was actually resolved.
evidence: pai_tools.py:244-245: `rebar.comment(_normalize_ticket_ref(ticket_id), body, ...)` then `return f"Commented on {ticket_id}."` — normalizes for the call but reports the raw ref
advisory.finding: `comment_ticket` returns the success message using the raw un-normalized `ticket_id` (`f"Commented on {ticket_id}."`), so a `rebar:<id>` or `[rebar:<id>]` input echoes the scheme/brackets back to the agent rather than the resolved id.
advisory.suggested_fix: Compute `ref = _normalize_ticket_ref(ticket_id)` once, pass it to `rebar.comment`, and use it in the `Commented on {ref}.` message.
